video_title: 2026 Hornets Training Camp Media Availability: PJ Hall

quotes.speaker: PJ Hall
quotes.summary_phrase: PJ Hall on his approach to training camp and team integration
quotes.excerpt: I'm not lollygagging around in the weight room, I make sure I get through my stuff with intensity
quotes.quote: I would just say being around. When we are playing, I make sure I go in there. I'm not lollygagging around in the weight room, I make sure I get through my stuff with intensity so that I can get up there and be around guys, watch them play, actually digest the basketball, and be around and support and continue to grow culture with them personally. And also that's also just my personality. I am easy to get along with. I like to think so. And so all these guys are so easy to get along with as well and so everybody kind of meshes together easily.
quotes.social_post: PJ Hall says he is prioritizing intensity in the weight room and building team culture during training camp to mesh with his new teammates.

quotes.speaker: PJ Hall
quotes.summary_phrase: PJ Hall on his connection to South Carolina and joining the Hornets
quotes.excerpt: My mom grew up here and so I still have family down here as well and so I love Charleston.
quotes.quote: A lot of the guys keep on saying, 'Yeah man, we are basically home for you.' And I'm like, I mean I'm about three and a half hours away, but my mom grew up here and so I still have family down here as well and so I love Charleston. It's awesome. Aside from that, obviously it's great to be here with the team and incredible opportunity. Even though I haven't been playing these first two days, I'm looking forward to getting after it hard, but it's been incredible to be here, digesting the basketball, learning our system, and getting to know the guys.
quotes.social_post: PJ Hall is settling into Charlotte and says it feels like home given his family ties to the area and his excitement to learn the Hornets system.

quotes.speaker: PJ Hall
quotes.summary_phrase: PJ Hall on his goals for versatility and system knowledge
quotes.excerpt: Just continue to grow my versatility, whether it be offensive or defensive, being able to play multiple positions.
quotes.quote: Just continue to grow my versatility, whether it be offensive or defensive, being able to play multiple positions. I think that's a goal as well. Knowing plays inside and out for other positions and kind of just knowing our system and being able to provide whatever it needs. Like, whatever opportunity is open in camp, I'm not ready to let it slip. And so I say, just always have your head up ready to go.
quotes.social_post: PJ Hall says his primary goal for training camp is to grow his versatility on both ends of the floor and master the Hornets playbook to be ready for any opportunity.

quotes.speaker: PJ Hall
quotes.summary_phrase: PJ Hall on his relationship with coach Brad Brownell and Hunter Tyson
quotes.excerpt: I talk to Hunter Tyson a good bit. We talk all the time. We've gone through some similar situations.
quotes.quote: I haven't talked to him in a few weeks, but I talk to Hunter Tyson a good bit. We talk all the time. We've gone through some similar situations in our professional career, but he's been great to lean on. But I spent a lot of time with coach this summer because my first six weeks, you can't really do anything after your surgery. So they were like, 'Go somewhere that you're comfortable,' before you come back to Charlotte. And so I was also in Clemson doing my rehab there and I was spending a lot of time with coach and a couple of the guys that were still around that I played with. And so it was awesome to be able to, when I heard, I called coach and told him what to happen. And I might have messed his golf round up, I probably caught him in the middle of a round, but he was like, 'Dude, come on up, get here tomorrow.' And so it's so nice to have a school that's welcoming back with open arms, taking care of me.
quotes.social_post: PJ Hall credits his recovery process to the support of his former coach at Clemson and says he has been leaning on Hunter Tyson for advice as he navigates his professional career.
